bibl.title: Necromancy, Divine Encounters, and Erotic Magic in Cupid and Psyche.

bibl.note: Psyche in the house of Cupid. - Psyche as corpse. - Psyche's lamp and sustasis rituals. - Aphrodite and erotic spells. - The Cupid and Psyche tale as a spell. - Draws parallels with the Greek magical papyri.
